versions.changelog:
Find Skills++ 5.3.0 introduces a major, comprehensive toolkit for skill discovery, security, and lifecycle management—far surpassing the original find-skills.

- Adds AST-level pre-install security scans with 4-tier risk classification and permission inventory, blocking EXTREME risks by default.
- Supports true offline skill ecosystem management with catalog sync—search and manage hundreds of skills without API access.
- Ensures reference integrity; detects incomplete or broken community skills.
- Features 0–100 quality ratings across seven metrics and redundancy pruning suggestions.
- Cross-source de-duplication, lifecycle handling (install, update, uninstall-to-trash), and backup.
- Includes a zero-dependency CLI (20 subcommands, 140 tests) for full local control, with demo and audit scripts for real-world validation.
- No collection or transmission of local user data; all scanning and records remain local for user privacy.
